ram_region.note: 1 MiB unified program/data memory per prompt Section 5

tensor_arena.measured_peak_use_bytes_rv32_firmware: not separately instrumented; firmware uses the same compile-time kTensorArenaSize=8192 constant and the same model, so the native-reference measurement (via MicroInterpreter::arena_used_bytes()) is the best available measurement of actual peak tensor-arena use for this exact model/op-resolver configuration
tensor_arena.note: Reserved capacity (8192 bytes, sw/app/wafer_common.h kTensorArenaSize) is distinct from measured peak use (5216 bytes, printed by sw/app/main_native.cc at startup). The firmware reserves the same 8192-byte static array but was not separately instrumented to print its own arena_used_bytes() over MMIO; the identical model/resolver/arena-size configuration makes the native figure a reliable proxy, not an independently RTL-measured figure.

memory_budget_check.note: headroom_bytes = available_before_stack_bytes - text_data_bss_bytes; verified at link time via the ASSERT in sw/startup/link.ld (link succeeds only if code+rodata+data+bss leave room before the reserved 64 KiB stack region).

heap_usage.note: newlib malloc/_sbrk is linked in (TFLM/libstdc++ require it) but this model's interpreter/allocator/op-resolver objects are all static/global (no dynamic heap allocation in the measured inference path); heap use was not separately instrumented and is expected to be minimal to zero for this model.

.tflite_file_size_is_not_runtime_ram.note: Per prompt Section 7: the .tflite file size (67880 bytes, stored as a read-only C array in .text/.rodata, already counted in the firmware text size above) is NOT the same as tensor-arena RAM consumption (8192 bytes reserved, 5216 bytes measured peak use).
